editorial_note: Comprehensive formal masterpage documenting Arthitean hypergenetics, Degree Q thresholds, Rhayhara's four-tier seal suppression and restoration cascade, strict dimensional separation of Bloodline Blessings (acquisition, quality, strength, growth dynamics), Cold-War adaptation, Hyperclan systems, and the PHK feedback factors.

concepts.name: Hypergenetics
concepts.canon_definition: The multi-layered hereditary architecture governing Arthitean physiology, lobe development, and metaphysical traits far beyond Mendelian molecular genetics.
concepts.clarification: Operates across physical DNA, paratemporal lineage resonance, and modal trait expression governed by Hypergendered Logic operators (PA, IH, PH, Γ).
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Standard genetics (Hypergenetics is modal and developmental, not reducible to nucleic acids).

concepts.name: RH Factors
concepts.canon_definition: Hereditary bloodline determinants unique to royal Arthratan lineages, establishing genetic capacitance and resistance against spiritual and cognitohazard corruption.
concepts.clarification: RH factors regulate the compatibility of individuals with higher Arthitean ontostates and bloodline blessing retention.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Rhesus blood factors in human medicine.

concepts.name: Degree Q
concepts.canon_definition: A quantitative and qualitative rating measuring the purity, concentration, and ontological resonance of royal Arthitean blood within a lineage.
concepts.clarification: Higher Degree Q unlocks advanced brain-lobe recruitment, higher wing maturation, and resistance to causal rewrites.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Social noble status (Degree Q is a metaphysical physiological invariant).

concepts.name: Bloodline Blessings
concepts.canon_definition: Metaphysical divine endowments uniquely possessed by Arthitean royal and warrior lineages. Historically hereditary and beginningless.
concepts.clarification: Possesses four strictly independent dimensions: Acquisition, Quality, Strength, and Growth Dynamics. Conflating these dimensions violates canon.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Spells or acquired powerups (Bloodline Blessings are inherent structural endowments).

concepts.name: Seal Factor One (Restored Strength)
concepts.canon_definition: The Ultraarsayne increase in just Rhayhara’s strength level of all her bloodline blessings that she previously possessed an equivalent rate of acceleration of growth in her bloodline-blessing strength, restored per seal removed.
concepts.clarification: Restores former strength without guaranteeing the return of her former rate of growth or former rate of acceleration of growth.
concepts.formal_logic: ΔS(BB) = Ultraarsayne(Former_Accel) per seal removed; ΔG ≠ guaranteed
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Full power unsealing (Only raw strength is restored; former growth dynamics remain sealed/lost).

concepts.name: Seal Factor Two (Restoration Acceleration)
concepts.canon_definition: The Ultraarsayne increase in Seal Factor One per seal removed.
concepts.clarification: Later seals restore exponentially greater increments of former strength than earlier seals.

concepts.name: Seal Factor Three (Interseal Metadifferential)
concepts.canon_definition: The Ultraarsayne of Seal Factor Two of the second-next seal to be removed per extent of Seal Factor Two of the next seal to be removed.
concepts.clarification: Calculates the meta-ratio between sequential future seal restorations.

concepts.name: Seal Factor Four (Negative Retroincrease)
concepts.canon_definition: The negatively rewritten Ultraarsayne increase in Seal Factor Three per peak hardship Rhayhara endures across an aleph-null extent of time. Whenever Rhayhara exerts herself, Seal Factor Four negatively and retroactively increases by an Ultraarsayne extent.
concepts.clarification: Through Negative Rewrite, this increase is rewritten to have never been caused by her exertion or by any rewrite, while the resulting suppression increase persists.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Self-weakening fatigue (Her exertion permanently reinforces the suppression architecture retroactively while erasing the causal link).

concepts.name: Pressurised-Enlightenment
concepts.canon_definition: A major breakthrough in Enlightenment that scales higher in countersurpassableness of Unprecedentedness of groundbreakingness when under greater pressure.
concepts.clarification: Direction: greater pressure → higher countersurpassableness. Operates within Archarthitean development.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Standard enlightenment under meditation (Requires existential combat or psychological pressure).

concepts.name: Supramajor
concepts.canon_definition: An extent of majorness so great that it retroactively acquires new Bloodline Blessings whose quality has a Toren index directly proportional to its Supramajorness.
concepts.clarification: CRITICAL CANON DISTINCTION: Supramajor DOES acquire new blessings. It is retroactive. It scales QUALITY, distinct from strength.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Strength enhancement (Supramajor governs retroactive acquisition and quality, not strength).

concepts.name: Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment
concepts.canon_definition: A Supramajor breakthrough in Enlightenment that scales higher in countersurpassableness of Unprecedentedness of groundbreakingness when under greater pressure. In Rhayhara, causes brightly glowing eyes and temporarily fiery hair.
concepts.clarification: Possesses all Supramajor properties: retroactively acquires new blessings with Toren-indexed quality.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Cosmetic super-state (The physical glowing/fiery manifestation accompanies profound retroactive ontological acquisition).

concepts.name: Cold-War Adaptation
concepts.canon_definition: Anticipatory biological, psychological, and physiological adaptation developed during the ancient standoff between rival Arthratan thrones and dynasties.
concepts.clarification: Arthitean physiology adapts preemptively to counter hostile biological and conceptual vectors before they are deployed in open warfare.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Reactive immunity (It is anticipatory and strategic, not merely reactive antibodies).

concepts.name: Talmorai
concepts.canon_definition: The elite Arthitean martial-adaptive lineage discipline specializing in physiological resistance, deep unstressableness, and recursive hardening under extreme environmental duress.
concepts.clarification: Integrates directly with zirunstressableness: extreme training becomes exponentially optimal.

concepts.name: Hyperclan 1 & 2 (Varvadeil Clan)
concepts.canon_definition: Specialized Arthitean clan organizations (specifically the Varvadeil Clan under Asmouth Varvadeil) dedicated to creating, incorporating, and maintaining biological and brain-lobe factors that feed recursively into PHK.
concepts.clarification: Ensures that every new mental lobe or physiological trait establishes a positive recursive feedback loop with the PHK engine.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Political factions (Hyperclans are genetic and physiological feedback engineering bodies).

concepts.name: Archarthitean Factor
concepts.canon_definition: A factor in the PHK loop; Toren of Pressurised-Enlightenment for increasing Bloodline Blessing strength per willpower used at the time the Pressurised-Enlightenment occurred.
concepts.clarification: NON-NEGOTIABLE CANON RULE: Does NOT acquire new bloodline blessings. Scales strength of existing/retroacquired blessings by willpower at occurrence.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: New blessing grant (Archarthitean factor exclusively strengthens; Supramajor acquires).

concepts.name: Arthitean Deity Factors One & Two
concepts.canon_definition: Factor One is Toren of Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment for increasing Bloodline Blessing strength per willpower at occurrence. Factor Two is Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment for Arthitean Deity Factor One, functioning as a recursive meta-amplifier within the PHK loop.
concepts.clarification: Factor One scales strength. Factor Two applies Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment directly to Factor One, creating stress-amplified exponential meta-recursion.
concepts.formal_logic: Factor_One = Toren(PH) × Willpower; Factor_Two = PH(Factor_One) ⟹ Exponential Loop Feedback
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Simple duplicate buffs (Factor Two is a meta-operator acting directly upon Factor One).

distinction_matrix.canonical_resolution: Acquisition determines possession (only Supramajor can retroactively acquire new blessings). Quality determines the intrinsic metacapacity of the blessing (Toren-indexed ∝ Supramajorness). Strength determines operational power output (amplified by Archarthitean & Deity Factor One per willpower). They are orthogonal dimensions.

In Rhayhara's seal architecture, removing a seal restores pieces of former strength level keyed to past growth acceleration, but does NOT guarantee the restoration of former growth rate or acceleration dynamics.
Archarthitean Factor never acquires new blessings; it exclusively strengthens existing ones. Supramajor is the sole mechanic that retroactively establishes new bloodline blessings.

distinction_matrix.distinction: Deity Factor One vs Deity Factor Two
distinction_matrix.canonical_resolution: Factor One is a first-order strength factor scaled by willpower. Factor Two is a second-order meta-operator that applies Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment directly to Factor One, amplifying the entire PHK recursive feedback loop.
